## Fanged Sea Serpent (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Large dragon (aquatic)  

**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +9  
 
  

**Defense**

 **AC** 25, touch 11, flat-footed 23 (+1 dodge, +1 Dex, +14 natural, -1 size)  

**hp** 120 (8d12+24)  

**Fort** +9, **Ref** +7, **Will** +6  

**Immune** paralysis and sleep, dragon traits  
 
  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 30 ft.  

**Melee** bite +12 (1d8+6 plus poison)  

**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

**Special Attacks** constrict (1d8+6), poison  
 
  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 13, **Con** 16, **Int** 5, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 6  

**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +13; **CMD** 25 (can’t be tripped)  

**Feats** Cleave, Great Cleave, Swim-By AttackB, Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  

**Skills** Perception +9, Stealth +6, Survival +9, Swim +21  
 
  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Bite–injury; *save* Fort DC 17; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Con; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.  
  

**Ecology**

 
**Environment** any aquatic  

**Organization** solitary, pair or swarm (3-20)  

**Treasure** none
